summary: Kemper Corporation filed an 8-K to report a reduction in its credit facility borrowing capacity from $600 million to $350 million, effective May 4, 2026. The company delivered notice to JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., the administrative agent under its Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated March 15, 2022. No board recommendation or advisors were mentioned. This action is described as part of an ongoing initiative to reduce corporate expenses, resulting in lower annual fees. There are no deal terms, as this is simply a routine reduction of available liquidity. The filing does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition or restructuring.
